operations.title: A paired physical Mackey object requires five independent certificates
operations.body: The required certificates are selector descent, power-Mackey compatibility, covariant transfer normalization, automorphism/composition naturality, and physical Betti realization. The first four are algebraically classified and do not imply one another; the five-site relative-chain certificate remains unavailable.

operations.body: Falsify the present separation by constructing a canonical source-derived five-site relative-chain pushforward with boundary covariance, orientation/multiplicity normalization, strict composition, and exact coefficient-Betti pairing without the identified lift data.
